commits.message:
style: enforce Google Java Format with Spotless plugin

commits.author: ivangfr
commits.message:
chore: enhance healthchecks and update dependencies

- Add proper healthcheck interval/timeout/retries to all Docker services
- Migrate from KafkaContainer to ConfluentKafkaContainer (port 9093)
- Update delete user endpoint to return 204 No Content
- Update README with Mermaid architecture diagram and new screenshots
- Add set -e to shell scripts for fail-fast behavior
- Simplify UserEventResponse DTO and fix test timing issues

commits.author: ivangfr
commits.message:
chore: update dependencies and refactor service classes

- Update Spring Boot from 4.0.0 to 4.0.6 and Spring Cloud from 2025.1.0 to 2025.1.1
- Bump MySQL to 9.5.0, Cassandra to 5.0.8, Maven to 3.9.15, and Zipkin to 3.6.1
- Convert UserService and UserEventService from interface+impl pattern to concrete classes
- Restructure maven-compiler-plugin with explicit compile and testCompile executions
- Make Cassandra keyspace/datacenter and MySQL credentials configurable via env vars
- Remove Include.EXCEPTION from ErrorAttributesConfig in both services
- Remove swagger screenshots and add endpoint documentation to README
- Add MIT License file, FUNDING.yml, and badge links to README
- Rename test classes from *ServiceImplTest to *ServiceTest
- Improve shell script with safer variable quoting and reduced timeout
- Rename docker-compose.yml to compose.yaml and update dependency references
